title: perf: Add fast path for parsing simple versions (digits and dots only)

verdicts.label: intended
verdicts.rationale: The PR adds a fast‑path that parses simple “digit‑and‑dot” version strings. It catches a ValueError from the fast parse and re‑raises packaging.version.InvalidVersion, turning a generic ValueError into the project’s own InvalidVersion type. The added tests (e.g. "1..0", "1.0.", "1..2.3", " .1.0", "1.0a 1", etc.) expect InvalidVersion to be raised, confirming the new behavior is intended.
